info.name: Warehouse Management - OData V4
info.description: Run all folders in order with Collection Runner, one iteration, against a development database. Creates unique test records, tests all four services, CRUD, queries, composed purchase order items, transfer side effects and validation, then deletes its records. Set baseUrl (default http://localhost:4004); no environment import required. Validation failures can reveal application bugs. Cleanup must run even if assertions fail. Direct StockMovements CRUD does not adjust stock balances. Uses development Basic authentication (admin/admin) via username and password variables. Set runExchangeRate=true to include the external exchange-rate request; it requires internet access.

item.name: Get product exchange rate (optional external API)

exec: pm.test("Source balance and availability", () => {const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.quantity).to.eql(80); pm.expect(b.availableQuantity).to.eql(70);});

pm.test("Transfer audit record", () => {const b=pm.response.json().value; pm.expect(b).to.have.lengthOf(1); const row=b.find(x=>x.quantity===20); pm.expect(row).to.be.an("object"); pm.expect(row.fromWarehouse_ID).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("sourceWarehouseId")); pm.expect(row.toWarehouse_ID).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("destinationWarehouseId")); pm.collectionVariables.set("transferMovement1",row.ID);});
pm.test("Source balance and availability", () => {const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.quantity).to.eql(75); pm.expect(b.availableQuantity).to.eql(65);});

pm.test("Transfer audit record", () => {const b=pm.response.json().value; pm.expect(b).to.have.lengthOf(2); const row=b.find(x=>x.quantity===5); pm.expect(row).to.be.an("object"); pm.expect(row.fromWarehouse_ID).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("sourceWarehouseId")); pm.expect(row.toWarehouse_ID).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("destinationWarehouseId")); pm.collectionVariables.set("transferMovement2",row.ID);});
